characters.name: Senna Dreck
characters.summary: a riverside smuggler who runs cargo past the Wardens' checkpoints at night.

characters.name: Corlas Wick
characters.summary: a retired Warden captain who now patrols the locks alone, still loyal to the old oath.

places.name: Mire's Landing
places.summary: a half-flooded lock-town where the river smugglers and the Wardens both keep a foothold.

lore.name: The Warden's Tithe
lore.summary: a debt law binding anyone who crosses the river checkpoints without a permit to years of unpaid service.

scene_prompts: Senna Dreck needs to smuggle a crate through Mire's Landing before the Wardens' dawn patrol.
Corlas Wick discovers a stranger trying to forge a Warden's Tithe writ at the lock-house.
A flood has cut off Mire's Landing from the mainland, and someone has to decide who gets the last boat out.
